description: Source code for initializing and managing LVGL input devices in Zephyr OS, including functions for registering input drivers, reading input data, and initializing various input device types based on configuration.

methods.name: lvgl_input_get_indev
methods.description: Returns the input device associated with the given device.

methods.name: lvgl_input_read_cb
methods.description: Callback function to read input data from the device.

methods.name: lvgl_input_register_driver
methods.description: Registers an input driver of a specified type for a device.

methods.name: lvgl_init_input_devices
methods.description: Initializes various input devices based on configuration.
